assessment_objectives.objective: the criteria used to assign Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR)-relevant criticality ratings to Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) are defined.
Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) are assigned a Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR)-relevant criticality rating in accordance with the defined criteria.
assigned criticality ratings are recorded against Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) entries in the asset inventory or an equivalent register.
the frequency at which to review assigned criticality ratings is defined.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change

assessment_objectives.objective: assigned criticality ratings are reviewed and updated at the defined frequency and when business functions or Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) change.
